service.method: SELECT CMGL.COMPANY_NAME_LOC , BAGL.CTRL_NAME_LOC , BAGL.COMPANY_CODE , BAGL.CTRL_CODE FROM SBAGL BAGL INNER JOIN SCMGL CMGL ON CMGL.COMPANY_CODE = BAGL.COMPANY_CODE INNER JOIN SBALN BALN ON BALN.HOUSE_CODE = BAGL.HOUSE_CODE AND BALN.COMPANY_CODE = BAGL.COMPANY_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_CODE <> BAGL.CTRL_CODE AND BALN.CTRL_PERSON_ID = ${USER_ID} WHERE BAGL.HOUSE_CODE = ${session.HOUSE_CODE} AND BAGL.COMPANY_CODE = ${COMPANY_CODE} ORDER BY BAGL.CTRL_CODE

INSERT INTO SBALN ( HOUSE_CODE, CTRL_PERSON_ID, ADD_DATE, ADD_TIME, ADD_USER_ID, CHANGE_DATE, CHANGE_TIME, CHANGE_USER_ID, DEL_FLAG, CTRL_CODE, COMPANY_CODE ) VALUES ( ${session.HOUSE_CODE}, ${USER_ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${session.ID}, 'N', ${CTRL_CODE}, ${COMPANY_CODE} )
